algorithm: push-relabel, evaluated from the EDGE cascade
note: pick-admissible-edge selects an arbitrary admissible edge; this trace is one sample

steps.caption: Saturate every edge out of the source:  f(s,v) = c(s,v).
Mirror the preflow as negative flow on the reverse edge:  f(v,s) = -c(s,v).  F is now antisymmetric.
Excess is net inflow; outflow is already stored as negative entries.

steps.expr: R_{1,u,v} = 0 if u=s ; C_{v,u} if v=s ∧ u≠s ; C_{u,v} otherwise
